name: Inter Stable Token
who_can_redeem: During operation, holders used supported PSM conversion routes and vault borrowers repaid IST to reclaim collateral. Inter Protocol sunset concluded in July 2025.
redemption_region_notes: Historical access depended on Agoric, IBC, PSM, vault, wallet, governance, and liquidity availability.
redemption_notes: IST was a protocol stable token and Agoric fee token, not a fiat issuer claim. Inter Protocol completed its sunset in July 2025 after disabling minting and closing exit paths.
summary: Agoric-native interchain stable token issued through Inter Protocol, launched with mainnet-1 in October 2022 and discontinued after the protocol sunset concluded in July 2025.
notes: Growth A / Batch Q. The 2025 wind-down, gas-token transition, reserve liquidation, and residual IBC representation boundaries remain separate from the 2022 launch identity.

name: USN
who_can_redeem: At wind-down, holders were directed to the USN Protection Programme, the Decentral Bank swap tool, or available market routes.
redemption_region_notes: Historical access depended on NEAR or Aurora interfaces, programme eligibility, liquidity, and service availability.
redemption_notes: USN launched with a NEAR and USDT reserve model, shifted to 1:1 USDT backing in June 2022, and entered a controlled wind-down on 24 October 2022 with permanent minting cessation. The final Protection Programme close and residual settlement boundary remain unresolved.
summary: NEAR-native stablecoin operated by Decentral Bank, launched in April 2022, shifted to USDT backing in June, and entered a controlled wind-down in October 2022.
notes: PR #302 preserves 2022-10-24 as the permanent mint-stop and controlled wind-down boundary, not the final terminal day. Final programme close, payout completion, residual obligations, final supply, and later market state remain unresolved.
